bullets.text: In Chennai, a young man tragically died after his bike lost control and he fell into accumulated rainwater.
Severe cyclonic storm Murasu uprooted at least 12 trees across Chennai, damaging houses and vehicles while inundating roads.
Pazhaverkadu in Thiruvallur experienced 10-foot-high rough sea waves and a four-day halt to fishing due to Cyclone Murasu.
Plastic garbage and waste accumulated in the Piliamman Temple pond in Taramani, Chennai, causing a severe foul smell.
Traffic congestion occurred near Kamatchi Hospital on the Pallavaram-Thoraipakkam radial road in Pallikaranai due to light rain and office hours.
In Gummidipoondi, sewage vehicle owners staged a protest by parking their vehicles inside the rural development office campus.
Agricultural authorities in Tiruttani advised farmers on methods to remove stagnant rainwater from fields and protect crops.
Liquor shops and bars within 5km of the Andhra Pradesh border in Thiruvallur were ordered to close temporarily for Chittoor local body elections.
Vultr announced a plan to build 1 GW of AI compute capacity in India by 2029, placing Chennai at the center.
Vultr launched a 20 MW AI supercompute cluster in Chennai, expanding its artificial intelligence infrastructure footprint in India.
MeitY released the DEPA framework handbook to help institutions unlock secure data sharing for artificial intelligence training.
The DMK IT wing launched severe criticisms regarding political and legal developments involving TVK fails and the Madras High Court.
